info.title: The Value Pool
info.subtitle: Real work keeps happening — commits land, detours get resolved — often faster than anyone updates the plan. The pool is where that work waits until it's credited to something.
info.principle: Nothing counts as delivered until it's claimed into a plan and that plan closes. Anything real that happened outside that loop sits in the pool.

info.claimTitle: How a unit leaves the pool
info.claimDesc: Pick an open plan item, hit Claim. That's the whole gesture.
info.claimNote: Claiming only runs one way. Once a unit is claimed, it never reappears in the pool — even if the same commit gets rescanned later.
info.healthDesc: The three numbers above are read straight from the server, never recalculated in this panel.

info.closing: The real test isn't whether work got done — it's whether it got closed. A shrinking pool means the team is finishing things, not just accumulating them.
